_comment: Example trusted-domain configuration. Domains listed here are recognized as official/known domains. This does NOT verify that any specific sender is legitimate — it only checks whether the domain in the sender address or URL matches a known list. Add or remove domains as needed for your use case.
_free_email_providers_note: Free email providers are not inherently suspicious, but they are commonly used in spam. A message from a free email provider should be treated with normal caution.
